title: These are pacifiers used in hospital nursery…
review_text:
These are the real deal! I was hesitant because of the price and… Being this is the only pacifier our baby will use, I needed this to be legit!!

Anyone in the market for the pacifier used at the hospital in the newborn nursery, this is it! These come in different sizes which is quite helpful for The varied size/stage of babies size mouth… Something too big can obstruct/choke or,
So big it’s useless, simply due to the fact their mouth isn’t big enough! I suggest starting with the size that matches babies age and adjust from there. A helpful hint to know if “too small”... when pacifier keeps sucking in and collapsing on itself, it’s time! Translation- their rooting mechanism is getting stronger/mouth bigger and time to size up! AND vice versa- With infant more petite.. maybe choose a smaller version or, stay at smaller size for a longer period of time. This is so helpful to offer sizing in three month increments- Ohh, did I mention they also make these in Preemie size too!!

Being fashion forward (ha!) these come in different colors and sizes- even gender neutral and make a fantastic baby gift or, gift topper!! Trust me, if using a pacifier with an infant and you only have a limited quantity of the “Golden binkie” that could be a little tricky if.. it goes missing!
YESS!! AVENT Is also the brand that makes the pacifier with the “vanilla scent!“ These will be marked and sold specifically as such…

Best part of all they added the ever- so simple and clever 2 circle cut outs to the pacifier right around the outside ring.. This allows you to attach to a “pacifier keeper” and keeps a pacifier from continuously falling to the carpet or nasty, dirty place- or, falling without your noticing.. only to get to the next place and it’s lost??!!
